name: Hector's Javelin
lore: The bronze-headed javelin of Hector, breaker of horses, last shield of Troy. He threw one like it at Ajax in the duel before the ships; it struck the boss of the shield and bent. Patroclus wore Achilles's armor when he fell to the next throw of its kind.
curve_note: base_damage = curve.weapon_base_damage(22) x 1.4 unique-mult, rounded for heavy spear feel. Class: heavy 5-rung [0.75, 0.90, 1.00, 1.30, 1.75]. F20-29 Asterion-era band fill.
